name: nzyme
description: How to use the @nzyme framework packages — dependency injection (@nzyme/ioc), logging (@nzyme/logging), translations (@nzyme/i18n, @nzyme/vue-i18n), Vue forms (@nzyme/vue-forms, @nzyme/validation) and composables (@nzyme/vue-utils, @nzyme/vue-ioc) — plus the TypeScript conventions and testing practice they are written for
